say:1:1533402001:1.source_cn: 朋友，我看你在这里站了这么长时间，是不是也觉得这座建筑...

say:3:1533402002:1.text: Yes! This stunning, intricate, grand, nothing-short-of-miraculous bridge!
say:3:1533402002:1.source_cn: 没错，就是这座美妙的、精巧的、宏伟的、堪称奇迹的桥！
say:3:1533402002:1.male: Yes! This stunning, intricate, grand, nothing-short-of-miraculous bridge!

say:4:1533402004:1.text: Ah, I see your understanding of this bridge remains... superficial.
say:4:1533402004:1.source_cn: 哎，看来你对这座桥的认知还是太过浅薄。
say:4:1533402004:1.male: Ah, I see your understanding of this bridge remains... superficial.
say:4:1533402004:1.female: Ah, I see your understanding of this bridge remains... superficial.

say:5:1533402005:1.text: Tell me, might I have a moment of your time? I wish to tell you the true story of this bridge: a miracle of Halian architecture, a testament to human ingenuity.
say:5:1533402005:1.source_cn: 你看，我能否占用一点你的时间？我想自己给你讲一讲这座桥...
say:5:1533402005:1.male: Tell me, might I have a moment of your time? I wish to tell you the true story of this bridge: a miracle of Halian architecture, a testament to human ingenuity.
say:5:1533402005:1.female: Tell me, might I have a moment of your time? I wish to tell you the true story of this bridge: a miracle of Halian architecture, a testament to human ingenuity.

say:6:1533402006:1.text: Before the Halians or the Wildborn, before the first dawn of civilization, the Taothos Rift split the land, sundering worlds for eons.
say:6:1533402006:1.source_cn: 在天地形成后，在呼临和雅库伯尔人诞生前，塔欧妥斯深壑就...
say:6:1533402006:1.male: Before the Halians or the Wildborn, before the first dawn of civilization, the Taothos Rift split the land, sundering worlds for eons.
say:6:1533402006:1.female: Before the Halians or the Wildborn, before the first dawn of civilization, the Taothos Rift split the land, sundering worlds for eons.

say:7:1533402007:1.text: Then this bridge appeared, a marvel connecting two worlds, altering the course of heaven and earth! It was never the bridge's intent to bring war and strife.
say:7:1533402007:1.source_cn: 直到这座奇迹的桥出现，将两界联通，令天地变化！
say:7:1533402007:1.male: Then this bridge appeared, a marvel connecting two worlds, altering the course of heaven and earth! It was never the bridge's intent to bring war and strife.
say:7:1533402007:1.female: Then this bridge appeared, a marvel connecting two worlds, altering the course of heaven and earth! It was never the bridge's intent to bring war and strife.

say:8:1533402008:1.text: Its purpose was connection, to stand as proof of life's defiance against nature. But such a vision was too grand... and carried unforeseen consequences...
say:8:1533402008:1.source_cn: 带来战火与纷争，并非是桥的意愿。它的意愿是连接，是展现...
say:8:1533402008:1.male: Its purpose was connection, to stand as proof of life's defiance against nature. But such a vision was too grand... and carried unforeseen consequences...

say:10:1533402009:1.text: Really? Do you truly grasp, in your heart, the greatness of this bridge?
say:10:1533402009:1.source_cn: 真的吗？你真的打心底清楚、明白这座大桥的伟大之处了吗？
say:10:1533402009:1.male: Really? Do you truly grasp, in your heart, the greatness of this bridge?
say:10:1533402009:1.female: Really? Do you truly grasp, in your heart, the greatness of this bridge?

say:11:1533402010:1.text: Then say it with me: All hail the Taothos Bridge!
say:11:1533402010:1.source_cn: 那你跟我一起说吧——赞美你，塔欧妥斯大桥！
say:11:1533402010:1.male: Then say it with me: All hail the Taothos Bridge!

say:13:1533402011:1.source_cn: 很好，很好！看来我又找到了一位志同道合的人！

say:14:1533402012:1.text: Please, carry on. I must continue admiring this architectural wonder...
say:14:1533402012:1.source_cn: 你请自便，我要继续再欣赏一下这座奇迹的建筑……
say:14:1533402012:1.male: Please, carry on. I must continue admiring this architectural wonder...

say:16:1533402003:1.text: No! War and conflict are but meanings imposed upon it by others. They are not its true essence!
say:16:1533402003:1.source_cn: 不！军事与战争只是他人强行赋予这座桥的意义，而不是它本身！
say:16:1533402003:1.male: No! War and conflict are but meanings imposed upon it by others. They are not its true essence!
